convertibility_reason: SuperTrend indicator now supported by generator. Uses standard ATR-based SuperTrend as approximation for CCI-based variant. Entry on up/down signal buffers.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timing
min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator calculation

other_exits: Opposite SuperTrend signal closes position (Up signal closes sell, Dn signal closes buy)
Double-check close: if both BuyPosOpen and BuyPosClose enabled and SuperTrend buffer 1 (Dn trend) is active, force close buy; symmetric for sell with buffer 0 (Up trend)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots); BALANCE=fraction of balance; FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin; LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin considering loss; LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance considering loss. The MM input value is interpreted differently based on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: Signal is evaluated on bar index SignalBar (default=1, previous closed bar). The EA uses 4 buffers from the custom SuperTrend indicator: buffer 0=Up trend line, buffer 1=Dn trend line, buffer 2=Up signal (non-empty on buy signal bar), buffer 3=Dn signal (non-empty on sell signal bar). There is a dual close check: primary close on signal reversal (buffer 2/3), plus a secondary close if the trend direction (buffer 0/1) is already opposite. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans allow independently enabling/disabling long/short entry and exit. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit suggests position tracking via global variables managed by TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate the SuperTrend indicator logic in Python since it's a custom indicator (iCustom). The SuperTrend likely uses CCI for trend direction and ATR for band offset - need to find or reimplement the exact algorithm. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles all position management including the MarginMode lot sizing logic - this must be reimplemented. The 4-buffer scheme (trend line + signal markers) must be understood from the SuperTrend indicator source. Signal bar offset of 1 means trades are on confirmed bars, not repainting. GlobalVariableDel_ suggests stateful position tracking that must be replicated.
